title: [GMCP 203.042.M] Mastery: Performance, capacity, fairness, and resource budgets
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-042-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Published latency, throughput, startup, memory, descriptor, CPU, disk and event-fanout budgets are enforced per server, tenant and gateway under representative and adversarial load. Admission control, backpressure and fair scheduling prevent noisy neighbors; benchmarks are reproducible across supported platforms; regression thresholds gate release; and overload degrades explicitly without deadlock or unbounded growth. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
